notes: Inbound from support automation vendor list; wants fast self-serve experience — low-touch onboarding

Throughput: small cluster during POC — ~10-30 reqs/sec peak per team (SMB), expect spikes during business hours
Cost sensitivity: requests likely priced tightly; looking for batching/cache suggestions to reduce cost
Security: requires SSO for admin, SOC2 compliance, audit logs for API keys, retention controls. Asked about KMS integration but will accept Redwood-hosted keys initially
Models: prefers mid-sized open models (fast + cheap); asked about Redwood model catalog and verified perf profiles
Tooling: wants structured-output validation, example schemas for ticket fields, and sample callback/webhook patterns — SE to provide example mappings
Quote from CS lead: 'We need summaries that agents can glance at — not poetic. Precise, terse, always include root cause and next step if present.'
POC acceptance criteria: 1) 80% of summaries match human judgment in sample eval set, 2) structured extraction accuracy > 85% on key fields, 3) cost per 1k tickets within estimated budget
